description.value: Famous Chicken (formerly known as Lee's Famous Recipe Chicken) is a fried-chicken fast food outlet on Marshall Road in Abbotsford. Fraser Health Authority inspection records covering 2012–2019 show a consistent low hazard rating, indicating a history of meeting food safety standards. The operation specializes in chicken with sides including gravy and fries served hot-held at the counter.
